scope: Read-only bounded source review during quiet window; no tests, browser, app, HTTP, Go, Docker or metrics execution

dependencyRead.scope: Selected existing dependency source spans read, full dependency bytes/hash not checked in this narrow review

findings.concrete: Bare finally awaiting each gate.dispose can replace the primary scenario assertion/timeout with a route-disposal error, and a first failing dispose skips later gates. No catch records the original error or monitor snapshot before cleanup.
findings.suggestion: Boundedly record allowlisted primary error stage and raw passive-monitor projection before cleanup; collect each gate cleanup result separately; rethrow original primary while retaining cleanup errors. If no primary exists, cleanup failure must still fail scenario.

findings.concrete: After await route.fulfill, remaining() and record() may throw; generic catch then attempts route.abort despite already fulfilled route. Playwright _checkNotHandled rejects handled routes; fulfillment and abort are terminal settlements, fetch alone is not.
findings.suggestion: Track the owned route operation attempt/success/uncertainty; never issue a second terminal operation following acknowledged or uncertain fulfill. Abort exactly once only if no terminal operation was attempted. Preserve unknown/incomplete settlement as failure.

findings.concrete: dispose releases the gate, calls page.unroute, then awaits completed. Playwright default unroute removes matching handler/interception without waiting active handler; this is not handler settlement proof.
findings.suggestion: Retain absolute8s gate deadline; make cancellation/settlement explicit and bounded, await exact handler settlement before removal, separately record bounded removal failure. Avoid treating unroute as permission to replay request or complete an ambiguous route.

findings.concrete: snapshot helper asserts monitor health; checkpointed wire snapshots are only later success-stage records. A failure before them can leave already-observed terminal frames outside the retained receipt.
findings.suggestion: Use bounded nonasserting monitor.snapshot in failure capture and record observation unavailable/errors separately; do not invent absent native exit, primary failure or original route owner.

limitations: Attempt4 original primary error and prior route settlement owner are not known from this source review. No claim that a specific candidate path caused that run.
No timeout relaxation, request retry, mutation replay or alternative manufactured stale session row is suggested.
A failed/late route operation remains uncertain even after browser cleanup.
